# British Solar Direct

> British Solar Direct supplies and installs turnkey LONGi EcoLife solar and battery packages for homeowners across Nottinghamshire, Derbyshire, Leicestershire, and South Yorkshire. Based in Kirkby-in-Ashfield, Nottingham NG17 8EY.

Fixed residential packages with local delivery and installation led by Company Director Juma Mohammedi. Call 0115 990 4024 or email info@britishsolardirect.co.uk for a fixed quote.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://britishsolardirect.co.uk/): Overview of turnkey LONGi EcoLife packages for Nottingham homes
- [Our Packages](https://britishsolardirect.co.uk/products): Cottage Setup, Family Homestead, and Estate Powerhouse systems
- [Installation](https://britishsolardirect.co.uk/installation): Survey, scaffolding, roof mounting, wiring, and MCS handover
- [Delivery & Logistics](https://britishsolardirect.co.uk/delivery-logistics): East Midlands coverage, exclusions, and delivery FAQ
- [Project Quote](https://britishsolardirect.co.uk/project-quote): Request a fixed quote with postcode and package details
- [Contact](https://britishsolardirect.co.uk/contact): Phone, email, and address for British Solar Direct

## Packages

- [Cottage Setup 4.3kW](https://britishsolardirect.co.uk/products/cottage-setup-4kw): 9× LONGi 480W panels with 5kWh hybrid battery for smaller homes
- [Family Homestead 8.6kW](https://britishsolardirect.co.uk/products/family-homestead-8kw): 18× LONGi 480W panels with 10kWh battery for 3–4 bedroom homes
- [Estate Powerhouse 12.4kW](https://britishsolardirect.co.uk/products/estate-powerhouse-12kw): 26× LONGi 480W panels with 15kWh storage for large homes and EV charging
